items.title: 67259_Big Chief Moore oral history interview
items.q: In the band I had Buck Clayton, the drummer this time was Kansas Fields... and we had a nice engagement in Columbus.

ctx.x: Kansas Fields was a drummer and Arthur Trappier was a drummer. At various times these people were with Sidney, but most of the time, just Sidney and I with a different piano player or different -- I heard this aircheck from the Buckminster Hotel in Boston -- what year was that, 1951 or something -- everything happened so fast. When I think of those years, I'd be with this group here and in two or three weeks I'm with another one or I'd be somewhere else up until 1949
